info.name: Artie Column Hashing Salts Connectors API

items.docs: Creates a new source or destination connector for your Artie deployment. Configure database connections, authentication, and replication settings programmatically.
Retrieves the full configuration and status of a connector by its unique identifier, including connection settings and current replication state.
Updates the configuration of an existing source or destination connector. Modify connection settings, credentials, or replication parameters for a running pipeline.
Permanently removes a connector and its associated configuration. This stops any active replication pipelines that depend on the connector.

info.name: Fetch table detail for a saved connector

items.docs: Returns detailed metadata for a specific table on the saved connector. Requires 'schemaName' and 'tableName' query parameters; 'isView' is optional.
Generates the SQL script to create shadow tables required for Oracle change data capture (CDC). Run this script on your Oracle source before starting replication.
Drops a PostgreSQL replication slot that is inactive or orphaned. Use this to clean up stale replication slots that may be preventing WAL cleanup on the source.
Initiates a point-in-time export from Amazon DynamoDB for the specified connector. Use this to backfill your destination with existing DynamoDB table data.

info.name: Fetch databases for an unsaved connector

items.docs: Lists available databases on the target using an unsaved connector configuration. Useful during connector setup to discover existing databases. Response metadata may include Iceberg S3 table bucket maintenance defaults.

info.name: Create a database on an unsaved connector

items.docs: Creates a new database on the target destination using a connector configuration that has not yet been saved. Useful during initial setup to prepare the destination.

info.name: Create a schema on an unsaved connector

items.docs: Creates a new schema on the target destination using a connector configuration that has not yet been saved. Useful during initial setup to organize destination tables.

info.name: Create a Snowflake warehouse on an unsaved connector

items.docs: Creates a new Snowflake virtual warehouse using an unsaved connector configuration. Useful during initial setup to provision compute resources for data replication.
Tests network connectivity and authentication for a connector configuration before saving it. Use this to validate connection settings during connector setup.

info.name: List PostgreSQL publications for an unsaved connector

items.docs: Lists logical replication publications on a PostgreSQL source using an unsaved connector configuration. Useful during connector setup to let users select an existing publication.

info.name: Fetch schemas for an unsaved connector

items.docs: Lists available schemas in a specific database using an unsaved connector configuration. Useful during connector setup to discover existing schemas.

info.name: Fetch tables for an unsaved connector

items.docs: Lists available tables in a specific database and schema using an unsaved connector configuration. Results are cached when a connector UUID is provided.
